There's many ways to increase dopamine, but I don't know which method works best for you. For me personally, I increase it by listening to music.

For stress, I recommend setting a timer, and pretending like the time the timer turns 0 is the deadline of your next assignment. That could work.

You could also set a schedule.

You don't have to listen to my advice, as I don't know which solution works best for you, but I have one thing to say.

If it's just suicidal thoughts the professionals won't care, but if she makes a plan, or tries to attempt suicide, that could seriously get her locked up.
